video.description:
Unlock the power of DeepEval, the open-source LLM testing framework that's revolutionizing how developers build, test, and trust large language models. In this comprehensive tutorial, we dive deep into DeepEval, often called the "pytest for LLMs," to ensure your AI applications are accurate, safe, and reliable before deployment.
Whether you're developing chatbots, RAG pipelines, or agentic systems, DeepEval provides a plug-and-play toolkit to measure everything from accuracy to hallucination and even toxicity. We'll walk you through the essential steps, from initial setup to running advanced test cases.

video.title: LLM Evaluation Framework Explained | RAG Metrics, AI Testing & Production Monitoring
video.rationale: Covers: topic ✓ (2:11–3:41), CO4.LO1 ✓ (6:35–8:05) [from transcript] · Micro Learning · tier 4 · 8:13 · 50 views · captions
video.description:
Learn how to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) using an enterprise-grade evaluation framework designed for AI applications in production. This tutorial covers the essential metrics, testing strategies, and monitoring techniques used by AI architects to measure model quality, reliability, safety, and business performance.

You'll explore how to evaluate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems by measuring both retrieval quality and answer generation accuracy. The video also explains advanced validation techniques such as Chain of Verification (CoVe), AI benchmarking, agent evaluation, hallucination detection, and human-in-the-loop review for building trustworthy AI applications.
